No contested cells this round - both captures agree on every pinned value. bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): no non-human character can have more than one class

bools.name: dgoDualAnyLevel
bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): a character can become dual-class at any level

bools.name: dgoDualKeepsOldAbilities
bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): the old-class abilities are never lost

bools.name: dgoDualNewClassFirstLevel
bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): considered a 1st-level character in the new class

bools.name: dgoDualXpToNewClass
bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): all later experience applies to the new class

bools.name: dgoDualNeverAdvanceOld
bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): the old profession can never be advanced again

bools.name: dgoDualNoHpUntilSurpass
bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): no new hit points until the old-class level is surpassed

bools.name: dgoDualRestrictionsUntilSurpass
bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): the new-class restrictions bind until the old level is surpassed

bools.name: dgoDualOldUseForfeitsXp
bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): using an old-class ability forfeits the adventure experience

bools.name: dgoDualBestTables

bools.name: dgoDualFreeMixAfterSurpass
bools.comment: Dual-class prose (capture p. 56): the two classes mix freely after surpassing the old level

bools.name: dgoDualWeaponsException

bools.comment: Alignment prose (capture p. 56): alignment is not religion; differing alignments share one religion

bools.name: dgoAlignLawMostCommon

bools.name: dgoLangSecondIsTrade

bools.name: dgoLangThirdIsAlignment

bools.name: dgoLangTradeBusinessOnly

bools.name: dgoLangNonHumanSpecial
bools.comment: Language prose (capture p. 59): non-humans often speak additional specialized racial languages

bools.name: dgoLangEveryOtherDayDoubles
bools.comment: Language prose (capture p. 59): seeing the teacher every other day doubles the study time

bools.name: dgoLangNativeSpeakersHalve
bools.comment: Language prose (capture p. 59): living among native speakers halves the learning time

bools.name: dgoLangAlwaysAccent
bools.comment: Language prose (capture p. 59): the student always retains a foreigner accent

bools.name: dgoLangNuancesNativeOnly
